title: Lok Sabha Passes Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill,2026
summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, on 6 August 2026. The Bill amends the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026....

blocks.content: The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, on 6 August 2026. The Bill amends the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026.

items: The Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, regulates payment systems in India, including electronic fund transfers and card-based payments.
UPI stands for Unified Payments Interface, and RuPay is an Indian domestic card payment network.
Merchant Discount Rate, or MDR, is a fee charged to merchants for accepting digital payments.
The Bank for International Settlements is an international financial institution based in Basel, Switzerland.
